meta.note: Same eight indicators for every basin. Definitions differ between basins: read "measure". "cmp" is a % change, or a difference in points when cmp_kind is "pts". "asof" is the end of the period described (for the outlook card, the date the estimate was built); age_days = generated − asof.

cards.label: Harvest, latest full year
cards.measure: Salmon and trout taken out of the sea for slaughter, all production zones, live (round) weight; gutted weight is about 0.888 of it.
cards.source: Fiskeridirektoratet biomass register

cards.label: Harvest so far this year
cards.measure: Fish taken out of the sea for slaughter since January, all production zones, live weight.
cards.source: Fiskeridirektoratet biomass register

cards.label: Fish in the sea
cards.measure: Biomass standing in the sea at the end of the month, all production zones, live weight.
cards.source: Fiskeridirektoratet biomass register

cards.label: Mortality
cards.measure: Fish reported dead in the month as a share of the fish standing in the sea (count), all production zones.
cards.source: Fiskeridirektoratet biomass register

cards.label: Sea lice
cards.measure: Average adult female lice per fish across the sea sites that reported a count (every site weighs the same), production zones 1–13; latest complete week.
cards.source: BarentsWatch Fish Health

cards.label: Average harvest weight
cards.measure: Harvested kilos divided by harvested fish in the month, live weight (about 0.888 of it gutted), all production zones.
cards.source: Fiskeridirektoratet biomass register

cards.label: Farms with fish
cards.measure: Sea sites with a salmonid licence that reported lice and were not fallow that week (slaughter holding cages left out); latest complete week.
cards.source: BarentsWatch Fish Health

cards.label: Outlook
cards.measure: Dashboard's own estimate from primary data, not an official forecast. Actual harvest to the last month published; rest of the year = same months a year earlier × our generation model (fish at sea, weights, growth, mortality — Generations tab). 2027 = the three generation scenarios (advance fades, central, advance kept), Oct–Dec 2027 assumed equal to 2026.
cards.source: Dashboard estimate; Fiskeridirektoratet biomass register, monthly harvest by farm (live weight × 0.888)

cards.label: Harvest, latest full year
cards.measure: Atlantic salmon only (coho and trout left out), harvest accumulated January–December, harvest (live) weight, preliminary.
cards.source: Subpesca monthly sector reports (Sernapesca preliminary figures)

cards.label: Harvest so far this year
cards.measure: Atlantic salmon only, harvest accumulated since January, harvest (live) weight, preliminary.
cards.source: Subpesca monthly sector reports (Sernapesca preliminary figures)
cards.note: Sep 2026 alone (difference of two cumulative reports): 73,000 t (−2.5 % vs Sep 2025).

cards.label: Fish in the sea
cards.measure: Biomass at sea of all farmed salmonids (Atlantic salmon, coho, trout), monthly series of Sernapesca's yearly health report; Chile publishes no current biomass for free.
cards.source: Sernapesca, yearly salmon-farming health report
cards.note: Fresher but unofficial: 386,000 t of Atlantic salmon (458,000 t all salmonids) at the end of Apr 2026 (Salmon Outlook figures quoted by Salmonexpert, entered by hand; no year-earlier point).

cards.label: Mortality
cards.measure: Atlantic salmon: share of the fish put to sea that died, on farms harvested in the year (closed cycles, count). A whole-cycle figure, not a monthly rate.
cards.source: Sernapesca, Informe Sanitario de Salmonicultura en Centros Marinos, año 2025 (March 2026)

cards.label: Sea lice
cards.measure: Number of times a farm was listed as a high-dissemination centre: 3 or more egg-bearing female lice (Caligus) per fish at the check after the treatment window. Chile publishes no farm-by-farm lice counts, so this count of flagged farms is the local measure.
cards.source: Sernapesca, sea-lice programme: list of high-dissemination centres

cards.label: Average harvest weight
cards.measure: Company figures, not a national average (none is published): Atlantic salmon harvested tonnes divided by harvested fish for the listed farmers that reported this quarter and the same quarter a year earlier.
cards.source: Company quarterly reports (filed with the Chilean market regulator)
cards.note: Companies: Salmones Camanchaca, Multi X, Blumar (53,078 t harvested in the quarter).

cards.label: Farms with fish
cards.measure: Sea farms in operation, all salmonids, monthly series of Sernapesca's yearly health report.
cards.source: Sernapesca, yearly salmon-farming health report
cards.note: Fresher but unofficial: 308 farms with fish at the end of Apr 2026 (Salmon Outlook quoted by Salmonexpert; may not count the same way).

cards.label: Outlook
cards.measure: Dashboard's own estimate from primary data, not an official forecast. Actual Atlantic salmon harvest to Sep 2026; the last three months ran at -2.1 % on a year earlier (it was +16 % for 2025 as a whole) — the rest of 2026 and 2027 are carried at that pace. Range skewed down (−7 / +3 points): an extraordinary El Niño and an algae emergency raise the risk of mass mortality; Chile publishes no current biomass for free.
cards.source: Dashboard estimate; Subpesca monthly sector reports: cumulative Atlantic salmon harvest (live weight × 0.888)

cards.label: Harvest, latest full year
cards.measure: Official yearly production of Atlantic salmon, live (wet) weight at harvest.
cards.source: Scottish Fish Farm Production Survey (Marine Directorate)

cards.label: Harvest so far this year
cards.measure: Harvest of the listed farmers that report every quarter (Mowi Scotland, Scottish Sea Farms, Bakkafrost Scotland; about 73 % of Scottish harvest), gutted weight. No national monthly or quarterly harvest is published.
cards.source: Company quarterly reports

cards.label: Fish in the sea
cards.measure: Biomass at sea summed over the farms' monthly returns to the environment agency (published months in arrears).
cards.source: SEPA monthly farm returns

cards.label: Mortality
cards.measure: Industry-wide monthly mortality: fish lost in the month as a share of the fish on the farms, as published in the header of the trade body's monthly report.
cards.source: Salmon Scotland, monthly mortality report

cards.label: Sea lice
cards.measure: Average of the weekly site counts of adult female lice per fish in the month (every count weighs the same; sites not counted that week are left out).
cards.source: Scottish Government, weekly sea-lice counts by site

cards.label: Average harvest weight
cards.measure: Official yearly production divided by the fish harvested, from the survey's tonnes and mean weight by year class; live weight.
cards.source: Scottish Fish Farm Production Survey (Marine Directorate)

cards.label: Farms with fish
cards.measure: Sites holding fish in the weekly sea-lice returns: sites with a count, plus sites not counted because of a withdrawal period before harvest, recent stocking or veterinary advice. Fallow sites left out.
cards.source: Scottish Government, weekly sea-lice counts by site
cards.note: The official yearly survey counts 210 active sea sites in 2025 (any site used during the year).

cards.label: Outlook
cards.measure: Dashboard's own estimate from primary data, not an official forecast. 2025 = official survey, 197,836 t live = 176 kt gutted (our cross-check from SEPA farm reports: 169 kt). 2026: the three farmers that report every quarter (73 % of the harvest) harvested 99.2 kt to Q3, -6 % on 2025, and plan 134 kt for the year (Mowi Scotland 74 kt, Scottish Sea Farms 40 kt, Bakkafrost Scotland 20 kt); that needs a strong fourth quarter (35 kt against 23 kt in Q4 2025), so watch t
cards.source: Dashboard estimate; Scottish Fish Farm Production Survey (Marine Directorate), quarterly reports of Mowi, Scottish Sea Farms and Bakkafrost, SEPA monthly farm reports

cards.label: Harvest, latest full year
cards.measure: National salmon harvest summed over the weekly slaughter statistics, gutted weight.
cards.source: Faroese Food and Veterinary Authority (HFS), weekly slaughter statistics

cards.label: Harvest so far this year
cards.measure: National salmon harvest since week 1, weekly slaughter statistics, gutted weight.
cards.source: Faroese Food and Veterinary Authority (HFS), weekly slaughter statistics

cards.label: Fish in the sea
cards.measure: Number of salmon in the sea at the end of the month, all farmers (fish counts by site; no national biomass in tonnes is published).
cards.source: Faroese Food and Veterinary Authority (HFS), fish by site

cards.label: Mortality
cards.measure: Company figure, not national: share of Bakkafrost's fish in the Faroes that died in the year. The Faroese authority publishes no national mortality rate.
cards.source: Bakkafrost, sustainability data page

cards.label: Sea lice
cards.measure: Average of the site counts of adult female lice per fish over the latest four weeks with counts (44 counts; every count weighs the same). The latest week can still be incomplete.
cards.source: Faroese Food and Veterinary Authority (HFS), lice counts by site

cards.label: Average harvest weight
cards.measure: Harvested kilos divided by harvested fish since week 1, national weekly slaughter statistics, gutted weight.
cards.source: Faroese Food and Veterinary Authority (HFS), weekly slaughter statistics

cards.label: Farms with fish
cards.measure: Sea sites holding fish at the end of the month, out of 32 sites in the fish-by-site file. The repo keeps no site list for a year earlier, so there is no comparison.
cards.source: Faroese Food and Veterinary Authority (HFS), fish by site

cards.label: Outlook
cards.measure: Dashboard's own estimate from primary data, not an official forecast. Almost all Faroese salmon is exported, so exports measure the harvest month by month. 2026 = exports to date + the rest of the year at the same pace. 2027: Bakkafrost — most of Faroese salmon — plans the same Faroese harvest in 2027 as in 2026 (97,000 t) with as many smolts put to sea; we keep 0 % ± 5.
cards.source: Dashboard estimate; Hagstova (Statistics Faroe Islands): salmon exports by month, converted to whole-fish equivalent

cards.label: Harvest, latest full year
cards.measure: Atlantic salmon from sea farms, slaughtered biomass summed over the twelve months of the dashboard (land-based farms left out; the file does not say whether the weight is live or gutted).
cards.source: MAST (Icelandic Food and Veterinary Authority), aquaculture dashboard

cards.label: Harvest so far this year
cards.measure: Atlantic salmon from sea farms, slaughtered biomass since January (weight basis not stated in the file).
cards.source: MAST (Icelandic Food and Veterinary Authority), aquaculture dashboard

cards.label: Fish in the sea
cards.measure: Biomass of Atlantic salmon in sea cages at the end of the month, all sea farms.
cards.source: MAST (Icelandic Food and Veterinary Authority), aquaculture dashboard

cards.label: Mortality
cards.measure: Tonnes of dead fish in the month divided by the biomass at sea at the end of that month. A weight-based rate: not directly comparable with rates counted in fish.
cards.source: MAST (Icelandic Food and Veterinary Authority), aquaculture dashboard

cards.label: Sea lice
cards.source: MAST (Icelandic Food and Veterinary Authority), aquaculture dashboard
cards.why_missing: No lice level in the repo for Iceland: the builder reads only the sea temperature from MAST's lice reports, not the lice counts themselves.

cards.label: Average harvest weight
cards.measure: Slaughtered tonnes of the month divided by the fish taken out of the sites (harvested fish, discards included), sea-farmed Atlantic salmon. Our own division of two dashboard series, not a published weight.
cards.source: MAST (Icelandic Food and Veterinary Authority), aquaculture dashboard

cards.label: Farms with fish
cards.measure: Sea sites holding Atlantic salmon at the end of the month (site-by-site fish counts).
cards.source: MAST (Icelandic Food and Veterinary Authority), aquaculture dashboard

cards.label: Outlook
cards.measure: Dashboard's own estimate from primary data, not an official forecast. Harvest to date from MAST; Q4 2026 and 2027 from our farm-by-farm simulation (growth, harvest weights, mortality) in three scenarios. The simulation has run high in past tests, so read the direction (down after a record 2026, with 30 % fewer fish over 4 kg at sea) more than the level.
cards.source: Dashboard estimate; MAST monthly farm reports (fish, weights, harvest by site)

cards.label: Harvest, latest full year
cards.unit: tonnes (as published, weight basis not stated in the repo)
cards.measure: Farmed salmon production, sum of the provinces Statistics Canada publishes (NS, NB, BC). Provinces it suppresses are left out, Newfoundland and Labrador among them when not listed. The latest year published lags by more than a year.
cards.source: Statistics Canada, aquaculture production by province
cards.note: NL 2025, from its own report: 34,215 t (Salmonids (Atlantic salmon 30,567 t + steelhead 3,648 t))

cards.label: Harvest so far this year
cards.measure: Exports, not harvest (no monthly harvest is published): domestic exports of farmed Atlantic salmon since January, all provinces and product forms added as shipped (whole and fillets, not converted to whole fish).
cards.source: Statistics Canada, merchandise trade database

cards.label: Fish in the sea
cards.source: Fisheries and Oceans Canada (DFO), British Columbia public reporting
cards.why_missing: No public figure: Canada publishes neither a national biomass nor fish numbers at sea (the federal files for British Columbia give stages and percentages per site, no fish or tonnes).

cards.label: Mortality
cards.measure: British Columbia only: simple average over the sea sites (26 sites) of the monthly mortality percentage each site reports, Atlantic salmon. Nothing comparable is published for Atlantic Canada.
cards.source: Fisheries and Oceans Canada (DFO), British Columbia public reporting, carcass classification by facility

cards.label: Sea lice
cards.measure: British Columbia only: average over sites (25 sites reporting) of motile sea lice (Lepeophtheirus salmonis, all mobile stages, not only adult females) per fish at routine counts; latest complete month.
cards.source: Fisheries and Oceans Canada (DFO), British Columbia public reporting, sea-lice counts

cards.label: Average harvest weight
cards.source: Fisheries and Oceans Canada (DFO), British Columbia public reporting
cards.why_missing: No public figure: no average harvest weight is published for Canada, and the federal site files give neither fish numbers nor tonnes to work one out.

cards.label: Farms with fish
cards.measure: British Columbia only: sea sites with a monthly report in the federal carcass file that month, that is, sites holding Atlantic salmon. No count of stocked sites is published for Atlantic Canada.
cards.source: Fisheries and Oceans Canada (DFO), British Columbia public reporting, carcass classification by facility

cards.label: Outlook
cards.measure: Dashboard's own estimate from primary data, not an official forecast. Level: Canadian salmon production of 2024 (Statistics Canada, plus Newfoundland's own report as Statistics Canada suppresses it), carried to 2025 by exports. Exports by province measure the change month by month. 2026 = exports to date + the rest of the year as a year earlier (the rule that tested best). 2027: British Columbia (53 % of the volume) from the cycle of every farm (DFO): +3 %; the Atla
cards.source: Dashboard estimate; Statistics Canada (CIMT): domestic exports by province of origin, whole-fish equivalent

cards.label: Harvest, latest full year
cards.unit: tonnes (as published, weight basis not stated in the repo)
cards.measure: Tasmanian salmon production added over the companies, by financial year ending 30 June.
cards.source: NRE Tasmania, salmon farming portal

cards.label: Harvest so far this year
cards.measure: Exports, not harvest (no monthly or quarterly harvest is published): Australian salmon exports since January, all product forms added as shipped. Exports are well below the yearly production, so they show only part of the volume.
cards.source: UN Comtrade, exports reported by Australia

cards.label: Fish in the sea
cards.source: EPA Tasmania / NRE Tasmania
cards.why_missing: No public figure: Tasmania publishes no biomass or fish numbers at sea (the repo holds a single company figure from one access-to-information release).

cards.label: Mortality
cards.unit: tonnes of dead fish in the month
cards.measure: Tonnes of dead salmon sent for disposal in the month (rendering, compost, landfill, ensiling, burial), all Tasmanian farms. A tonnage, not a rate: no monthly mortality percentage is published.
cards.source: EPA Tasmania, salmon mortality waste

cards.label: Sea lice
cards.source: EPA Tasmania / NRE Tasmania
cards.why_missing: No public figure: no sea-lice counts are published for Tasmanian salmon farms, and the repo has none.

cards.label: Average harvest weight
cards.source: NRE Tasmania
cards.why_missing: No public figure: no average harvest weight is published for Tasmania, and the repo has no fish numbers to work one out.

cards.label: Farms with fish
cards.source: NRE Tasmania
cards.why_missing: No count of farms holding fish is published. The repo only lists 28 marine leases of one area (D'Entrecasteaux Channel & Huon River), with no stocking status and no history.

cards.label: Outlook
cards.measure: Dashboard's own estimate from primary data, not an official forecast. Volumes are Tasmanian financial years (FY 2024/25 shown as "2025", FY 2025/26 as "2026"). Dead fish disposed of Jan–Sep 2026: 14,874 t, -16 % on a year earlier. If mortality keeps falling, more fish reach harvest: +5 % (0 to +10 %); the summer of 2027 (January–March) is the test.
cards.source: Dashboard estimate; Tasmanian production by company (financial years July–June) and EPA Tasmania monthly mortality disposal
